prose.title: What's Included, and How We Work

included.title: What's included in every project?
included.desc: Every site we deliver — whatever its size — ships with the same foundation: 90+ Lighthouse performance, technical SEO, Arabic/English bilingual support, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, a dashboard your team can run without a developer, and analytics configured from day one. These are not paid add-ons; they are baselines we never compromise.

process.title: How do we work with you?
process.desc: We start with a discovery session about your audience and goals — before talking about looks — then an interactive prototype you try with your own hands before a single line is written. During the build you see progress weekly and steer it immediately: no launch-day surprises. After launch we stay close: performance monitoring, iterative improvements, and a site that grows with your business.

included.title: What's included in every project?
included.desc: Every automation system we build ships fully documented with clear flow diagrams, dry-run tests before delivery, monitoring logs that show everything as it happens, and restorable backups for every flow. An automation you do not understand is one you do not own — so we hand over full ownership with training for your team.

process.title: How do we work with you?
process.desc: We start with a full audit of your tools and daily routine: what repeats, what gets forgotten, what eats time. We sketch the proposed flows and review them with you before building, then implement in stages — each flow tested alone before linking to the next. At delivery the system is fully yours, with an optional monthly maintenance plan.

hero.title: The Story
hero.subtitle: A small digital agency with an enormous obsession for detail.

story.title: Why We Exist
story.p1: Elyra started with a question that bothered us for a long time: why do people have to choose between a beautiful site that runs slowly, and a fast site that looks dull? Between a powerful system that intimidates its users, and an easy tool that lets its owners down?
story.p2: We decided not to choose. We design with beauty that stops the scrolling, engineer with precision that respects every millisecond, and automate whatever can be automated to give humans their time back — this is Elyra's covenant with every client.
story.p3: Today, after more than 120 projects spanning websites, platforms and automation systems, we're still the same team: small, obsessed, and asking every single time — is this more beautiful than what came before?

beauty.title: Beauty First
beauty.desc: Beauty isn't decoration — it's respect for a visitor giving you two seconds of their life. Every pixel needs a reason.

precision.title: Precision as Engineering
precision.desc: Deadlines that are honored, code that is tested, performance that is measured. Precision isn't a slogan; it's a daily operating system.

humanAutomation.title: Automation That Serves People
humanAutomation.desc: We automate routine to free time for creativity — not to replace humans, but to return them to what they do best.

m1.name: Ahmad Al-Rifai
m1.bio: Eight years building platforms before Elyra; believes the best code is the kind you never have to read twice.

m2.name: Sara Qabbani
m2.bio: Designs interfaces as silent conversations with the user — every pixel a sentence, every whitespace a breath.

m3.name: Mohammad Issa
m3.bio: Built 90+ automation flows for clients across six countries; insists routine is a human mistake, not fate.

m4.name: Layla Haddad
m4.bio: Asks "why?" five times before any "how" — that is how experiences that stick get built.
